Any unforeseen incompatible code fact triggers FailurePlaybook/new D#; product check-profile still records actual changed files and proof dependencies under D25. Ledger unit→item maps and original 23 source hashes preserved, no lost OPUS coverage asserted by prose alone—structural/coverage/byte checks recorded in validation.
Design only. No product PHP/Pest/DB/CI, negative-control execution, independent audit or GREEN. Native old plan-work Markdown design protocol not used; canonical plan.py authoring/check/render and authored hash closure recorded, no Task-signed independent fingerprint claim.
